sourceData.readingMnemonic: You let meat <kanji>rot</kanji>. You're a <reading>foo</reading>l (<ja>ふ</ja>). That's really all I can say at this point.
sourceData.meaningInfo: Imagine the smell of rotten meat hanging from your canopy. Now no one wants to come near here.
sourceData.readingInfo: What, did you think attaching this meat to the canopy would make it turn into jerky or something? Fool...
